name: london-chess-club
description: London Chess Club monorepo: Angular frontend + Node/Express backend
author: Michal Wiraszka

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C frontend run start" "pnpm -C backend run start"
scripts.test: pnpm -C frontend run test && pnpm -C backend run test
scripts.lint: pnpm -C frontend run lint && pnpm -C backend run lint
scripts.format: pnpm -C frontend run format && pnpm -C backend run format
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C backend install
